ths.text: Anax is the eldest son of King Athanas of Akros, but his father looks proudly at his younger brother Timoteus and contemptuously at him in front of the soldiers.
Anax befriends Zotikos in the gymnasium, and with the Iroan Games four months away, he asks the former pankration competitor Kaletor to train him after the champion Sinon refuses.

At the Games he draws Timoteus, baits him into a kneebar, reverses it into a heel hook and wins, then publicly rebukes his brother for trying to cripple him, which earns the crowd's respect even though Anax loses his next bout.

Later, as King of Akros, Anax challenges Rhordon while Cymede and Daxos unleash the Deyda River and sweep away Rhordon's horde, and though Mogis secretly aids Rhordon and Anax is wounded, Elspeth saves him.
After the Great Revel Anax dies, Cymede is missing, and their niece Taranika becomes regent.
